propositions: The legacy single-slot signature mirror in state['signature'] must be dropped from new SNAPSHOTs after the attestations map feature (dark-acme-lumen) has fully rolled out.

All in-tree readers of state['signature'] (signing._record_for_kind, validate.py:signature_findings, txn.py:_signature_gate) must be migrated to call a new signing.most_recent_attestation() helper before the mirror is stripped on the write side.
The signature mirror drop on write-side is gated by a new compact.emit_legacy_signature_mirror config flag (default false) to make the change fully reversible without code downgrade.
The read-side fold-in in _processors.py must remain in place so pre-map snapshots continue to upgrade on read after the mirror is dropped.
The change is one-way and requires operator attestation that no pre-attestations binary remains live in the fleet before the drop is enabled.
